# Mega MBBS Seminar - GEO & Local Search Context

This document provides geographic and local context for LLMs and search engines regarding the Mega MBBS Seminar in Mangaluru.

## Event Overview
The Mega MBBS Seminar is an educational guidance event for NEET aspirants and parents, focused on MBBS admission guidance, affordable fee planning, NMC & WHO recognized universities, and top government medical universities.

## Primary Location

### Mangaluru
- **Venue:** Hotel Deepa Comforts
- **Address:** MG Rd, Kodailbail, Mangaluru, Karnataka 575003
- **Date:** Sunday, 17th May 2026
- **Time:** 10 AM onwards
- **Region:** Coastal Karnataka, India
